text:
elaine: quick sync 0m need final decisions on enterprise compliance slices for H1: audit log retention choices, BYOK/KMS priority, SOC2 artifact delivery, and export/search SLAs. who wants decision ownership?

sam: happy to own runtime/perf tradeoffs. key point: searchable long-term retention=heavy index costs. recommend tiered model: hot/warm/cold.

nisha: security/compliance: BYOK handshake + KMS escrow are top risk areas. suggest a pilot for BYOK first (customer-managed keys + attestation) before GA. include SOC2 artifact dump in the pilot acceptance criteria.

william: from field: two enterprise prospects asked for 7yr immutable audit + BYOK. they'll pay for pilot. timeline: pilot in 8-10 weeks preferred.

maria: infra constraints: keeping 7yrs searchable is unrealistic cost-wise. propose defaults: 90d searchable hot, 2yr warm (restore within hours), 7yr cold archive (export-only). also add export API for legal discovery.

elainE: spelling of name wrong? Wait must keep as 'elaine'. continue.

elaine: draft product proposal: MVP = BYOK onboarding (key upload, rotation guidelines, attestation docs), audit export API, retention tiers set to 90d hot, 2yr warm (nearline), 7yr cold (archive). Search SLA only on hot.

sam: detailed limits: hot=real-time search, warm=nearline restore <=2h if requested, cold=export-only with no search SLA. sample export flow:
```
GET /audit/export?tenant=acme&start=2023-01-01&end=2023-12-31
200 -> {"signed_url":"https://storage.redwood.../acme-2023.zip"}
```

nisha: compliance acceptance for MVP: BYOK onboarding validated with one customer, SOC2 evidence bundle exportable for 30-day window, immutability guarantees for hot writes, and audit logs integrity proof (hash chain).

william: sales will prepare pilot package and price. i can own coordinator role; need a short one-pager + pilot checklist.

maria: ops estimate: indexing + hot storage = ~20% incremental run cost for a 2-customer pilot. export egress and restore ops are extra. finance sign-off required.

elaine: action items:
- sam: final tech design + perf numbers by Tue (owner)
- nisha: SOC2 artifact checklist, integrity tests, BYOK test plan by Wed
- william: sales one-pager + pilot cohort list by Wed EOD
- maria: ops cost model + export runbook by Thu
- jen: legal wording for opt-in warm search + SLA by Thu
- elaine: consolidate launch criteria doc and schedule decision block Fri

devops-bot: reminder: deploy freeze window Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC  avoid infra merges during pilot prep :robot_face: 

sam: quick follow-up: allow customers to opt into making warm searchable for a fee? that could meet enterprise asks without continuous indexing for everyone.

nisha: agree, opt-in searchable warm tier ok if contract clearly states search SLA and data residency implications. legal to review.

\ew: jen: i'll draft opt-in contract language and a breach/revocation flow for keys.

elaine: consensus: phased rollout. MVP = BYOK pilot + retention tiers (90d hot, 2yr warm, 7yr cold). search guaranteed on hot; warm search opt-in. i'll draft acceptance criteria and circulate. thanks all :raised_hands:
